name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Free Distribution of Bicycles - DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit: - The girl students of class VIII of Government Schools of this UT will be provided bicycle for free.

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in class VIII(8) in Government School of the UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.
